title: ASN.1 Decoder
subtitle: Decode ASN.1 BER/DER blobs and SNMP, Kerberos, LDAP, CMS, PKCS and OCSP                  messages into SQL rows.
provenance: Actual catalog tags from the released runtime used by the notebook

runtime_export.query: SELECT database_name, comment, map_extract_value(tags,'vgi.title') AS title, map_extract_value(tags,'vgi.subtitle') AS subtitle FROM duckdb_databases() WHERE map_extract_value(tags,'vgi.title') IS NOT NULL
rows: Generic ASN.1 BER/CER/DER decode plus SNMP/Kerberos/LDAP/CMS/PKCS/OCSP structural decoders for SQL.
Decode ASN.1 BER/DER blobs and SNMP, Kerberos, LDAP, CMS, PKCS and OCSP                  messages into SQL rows.
